column1: # 02_merge_runs.sql asserts sign=+1 unconditionally and appends, so a second run
#   doubles every run and doubles concurrency. Peak went 2,829 -> 5,658.
# TWO INVARIANTS THAT LOOK LIKE THEY SHOULD CATCH IT, AND DO NOT:
#   closure sum(delta) stayed 0, because each duplicated +1 arrives with its own -1.
#   max_runs_per_session_minute stayed 1, because the duplicate run has an IDENTICAL
#     key, so GROUP BY collapses it into one group with sum(sign)=2 rather than two
#     overlapping runs. It detects overlap, not repetition.
# THE ONE THAT DOES: sum(sign) per (session, run_start, run_end) must be exactly 1.
#   Clean database: 0 groups above 1, max 1. Corrupted: all 17,604 groups at 2.
# An earlier version of this artifact claimed max_runs_per_session_minute caught it.
#   That was wrong and was corrected by running the query instead of reasoning about it.
